important_factors: Active promotion PROMO-1 ends on 2026-09-23, after which daily demand reverts to the baseline forecast of 50 units/day.
Current usable inventory is 1,000 units with zero open purchase orders, leaving a 400-unit gap against the 1,400-unit 28-day demand forecast.

args.rationale:
Recent sales averaged 130 units/day due to promotion PROMO-1 (Spike promo), which runs from 2026-09-07 to 2026-09-23 with a 2.6x uplift factor. Per demand guidance, promotional uplift must not be extrapolated across the entire planning horizon. After PROMO-1 ends on 2026-09-23, demand reverts to the standard forecast of 50 units/day, giving a total 28-day forecast of 1,400 units.

Current usable inventory is 1,000 units with 0 open orders. Without replenishment, inventory would run out on 2026-10-07, creating 400 units of unmet demand and falling below the 200-unit safety stock limit on 2026-10-03.

Simulating the replenishment options confirms that creating a PO for 600 units from SUP-A ($14.00/unit, 7-day lead time) arriving on 2026-09-24 completely eliminates the 400-unit shortage and restores closing inventory to the required 200-unit safety stock level. Ordering 3,550 units (extrapolating the sales spike) would breach the 12-day maximum cover policy by leaving 3,150 units of excess stock.

The 600-unit order costs $8,400.00, which fits within available budget ($50,000.00) and warehouse capacity (45 m³ peak occupancy vs 200 m³ headroom). Because the spend exceeds the $2,000.00 autonomy limit, it is submitted for buyer approval.
